newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY MIXED ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS THURSDAY MIXED ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted mixed against major currencies at the close of a rather dull Thursday interbank session, dealers said.
"It was a very quiet market. We just saw a little bit of (U.S. dollar) buying but it wasn't much," one dealer said.

He said the local currency ended the day at 11.6350/6450 on the U.S. dollar, slightly weaker compared to Wednesday's 11.6300/6400 but was firmer on sterling at 18.4000/4500 from 18.5615/5990, in response to a stronger U.S. dollar overseas.
It was at 6.1995/2180 from 6.1895/2020 versus the mark but closed slightly up on the rand at 2.4805/4850 compared to 2.4860/4910.
